subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should Antigravity automatic mode preserve one aligned quota lane across menu-bar display and highest-usage ranking, or intentionally use reset-focused display and maximum-usage ranking as separate contracts?
rationale: Release history explicitly aligned these consumers and preferred usable lanes, while the PR intentionally changes both choices; tests cannot determine which user-facing policy the repository wants.

options.title: Preserve one aligned lane
options.body: Surface the binding exhausted quota consistently in automatic menu display and highest-usage ranking so the visible percentage explains why the provider won.

options.title: Approve context-specific semantics
options.body: Keep reset-focused menu selection and maximum-used provider ranking as distinct behaviors, then document and directly prove the intentional mismatch.

options.title: Keep shipped usable-lane preference
options.body: Reject the exhausted-lane behavior change and continue selecting an available quota lane whenever one remains usable.

recommendation.title: Preserve one aligned lane
recommendation.body: Surface the binding exhausted quota consistently in automatic menu display and highest-usage ranking so the visible percentage explains why the provider won.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available decision owner for changing the shipped automatic-selection contract.
